experiment_data.hypothesis: DANN (Domain-Adversarial Neural Network) learns strategy-invariant feature representations via gradient reversal, improving cross-strategy LOSO depth classification from naive RF 59.1% and two-stage 70.5% to 73-75%+. The shared encoder + adversarial strategy discriminator forces the model to extract depth-discriminative features that are invariant to decoding strategy differences. If delta vs two-stage >= 3pp, becomes main method contribution in §3.

metrics.best_fold: OLMo hold-out topk: DANN 57.87% vs RF 54.81% (+3.06pp)
metrics.worst_fold: GPT2XL hold-out temp: DANN 53.68% vs RF 56.18% (-2.50pp)
